nodes.label: ADR 0021: Cloudflare Workers Cron as Scheduled-Job Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Use CF Cron Triggers + scheduled handler dispatching to oRPC service functions. Crons declared in wrangler.jsonc: 0 * * * * (C.1 webhook backfill), 30 2 * * * (C.5 reconciliation), 0 9 * * * (C.6 onboarding-stuck alert). Work runs inside ctx.waitUntil. Lazy imports per cron to keep cold-start cost off the fetch path. Manual triggers call the same service function from an oRPC handler — identical code path.
alternatives_rejected: External cron (separate deploy dependency, service-key auth, schedule in different config)
Durable Object alarms (wrong shape for platform-scoped crons; DO is per-tenant shape)
